subject: maths
question: Manish invested a certain sum of money at 10% per annum simple interest. If he receives an interest of ₹72780 after 1 year, the sum (in ₹) he invested is:
solution:
**Given:**

Interest (I) = ₹72780

Rate (r) = 10% per annum

Time (t) = 1 year

**Formula used:**

I = P × r × t / 100

Where, P = Principal amount

**Calculations:**

72780 = P × 10 × 1 / 100

⇒ 72780 = P × 10 / 100

⇒ 72780 = P × 0.1

⇒ P = 72780 / 0.1

⇒ P = 727800

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
